component.name: Anker Webcam Settings
component.summary: Adjust Anker PowerConf C200 and AnkerWork C310 webcams on Linux

description.p: A small settings panel for Anker PowerConf C200 and AnkerWork C310 webcams. It exposes the vendor controls the official Windows and macOS app offers (field of view, HDR, exposure smoothing, Face AE, exposure compensation and more) alongside the standard UVC controls, with a live preview so you can see the effect.
Settings profiles can be saved and restored, and the bundled command-line tool can re-apply a profile automatically when the camera is plugged in.
